R5.arithmetic: One stock type. Kreg-corrected lengths: Base 20 + 16 + 12 + 8.5 = 56.5; Sides 6 x 11.75 = 70.5; Top Left 8 + Top Right 7 = 15; total 142 in + kerf. Bought: 1 x 8' = 96 in (explicit ' unit). 142 > 96. A 3 1/2" wide board yields one 2" strip, so ripping does not add length. Confidence likely only because quantity 1 could be an importer default (importDiffs show no evidence either way).
R5.reason: Parts need 142 in of 2"-wide strip; one 96 in board is bought.
